title: Multiplying and dividing
description:
Write these functions:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `square(x)` | x × x |
| `mul_add(a, b, c)` | a × b + c |
| `quotient(a, b)` | a ÷ b for **signed** numbers, rounded towards zero like C: `quotient(-7, 2)` is −3 |
| `remainder(a, b)` | the signed remainder: `remainder(-7, 2)` is −1 |
| `minutes(seconds)` | the whole minutes in an **unsigned** number of seconds: `minutes(125)` is 2 |
| `last_digit(n)` | the last decimal digit of an unsigned n |

The tests never divide by zero. Remember: `div` and `idiv` need `rdx` prepared, take their divisor in a register, and overwrite `rdx`. Note that the second argument arrives in `rsi` while `rdx` is about to be used for the division.

starter.solution.asm:
square:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

mul_add:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

quotient:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

remainder:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

minutes:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

last_digit:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
square:
        mov     rax, rdi
        imul    rax, rdi
        ret

mul_add:
        mov     rax, rdi
        imul    rax, rsi
        add     rax, rdx
        ret

quotient:
        mov     rax, rdi
        cqo
        idiv    rsi
        ret

remainder:
        mov     rax, rdi
        cqo
        idiv    rsi
        mov     rax, rdx
        ret

minutes:
        mov     rax, rdi
        xor     edx, edx
        mov     ecx, 60
        div     rcx
        ret

last_digit:
        mov     rax, rdi
        xor     edx, edx
        mov     ecx, 10
        div     rcx
        mov     rax, rdx
        ret

hints: `minutes(-1)` treats −1 as the unsigned number 18446744073709551615, so it must use `div` with `rdx` cleared, not `idiv`.
rules: Fill rdx with cqo before the signed division.
unitTests:
test "square"
    square(12) == 144
    square(-9) == 81
    square(3000000000) == 9000000000000000000
test "mul_add"
    mul_add(6, 7, 0) == 42
    mul_add(-3, 4, 20) == 8
test "signed quotient"
    quotient(17, 5) == 3
    quotient(-7, 2) == -3
    quotient(7, -2) == -3
    quotient(-100, -10) == 10
test "signed remainder"
    remainder(17, 5) == 2
    remainder(-7, 2) == -1
    remainder(7, -2) == 1
test "unsigned division"
    minutes(125) == 2
    minutes(59) == 0
    minutes(3600) == 60
    minutes(-1) == 307445734561825860
    last_digit(4072) == 2
    last_digit(9) == 9
    last_digit(18446744073709551615) == 5
